_about: Official figures that replace the Yahoo Finance values for the listed fields, where Yahoo is known to be wrong. Each figure is copied verbatim from the company's own audited filing (₹ crore). The data build applies them and records which fields came from which source; the app shows the source beside the figures. Add a company only with a primary source (the company's results or its exchange/SEC filing), never a secondary website.

HDFCBANK.reason: Yahoo Finance mixes bases for HDFC Bank: its net worth (₹7.68 lakh crore at 31 Mar 2025) is not the bank's standalone or consolidated shareholders' funds, while its profit is close to standalone, so ROE came out near 9% instead of about 14%.
HDFCBANK.source: HDFC Bank audited standalone financial results, as filed with the US SEC (Form 6-K, Exhibit 99)
HDFCBANK.checks: For every year pbt - tax = pat and capital + reserves_and_surplus = net_worth, to the paisa.
